title: Prove workspace tools reject malformed and unsafe inputs
goal: Strengthen regression evidence that workspace read and write tools fail closed for malformed JSON, invalid field types, unexpected keys, protected paths, and secret-like content.
context:
Issue #347 requires explicit fail-closed regression tests around the real workspace tool boundary. Existing tests cover several unsafe cases but often accept any thrown error, which can hide a wrong failure mode. This task tightens the contract and applies a narrow production repair at the existing tool boundary. A CI run then exposed a production edge case: LocalAgentWorkspace throws protectedContent before WorkspaceReadTool can translate the read error or let search skip that file. The same task now includes a narrow tool-boundary repair.

Checkpoint 2026-11-08: Added testRejectedSecretWriteDoesNotReplaceExistingFile on PR #564. It verifies the real WorkspaceWriteTool rejects a secret-like overwrite with the explicit error and preserves the existing file contents. Initial CI: M3 passed; Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA passed; Agent Task Contract failed because the PR changed a test file without changing exactly one Tasks/active/*.json contract. Updating this task record is a contract-compliance fix, not a change to validation policy. CI must be rerun on the updated PR head.
forbidden_changes: Do not weaken production workspace, policy, path, secret-scanning, or size-limit behavior; only translate the existing protected-content error and let search skip protected files.
Do not weaken existing assertions or accept arbitrary errors for a specific rejection contract.
Do not add dependencies or modify runtime architecture.
Do not claim physical-device acceptance without a real iPhone test.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed JSON is rejected with the explicit JSON-object input error.
Wrong field types, missing required fields, and unexpected fields are rejected with their corresponding explicit input errors.
Protected workspace paths and secret-like write/read content are rejected with the expected error category.
Rejected write operations leave no file and do not mutate existing content.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
A direct read of a secret-like file returns the explicit workspace secret-content rejection, while search skips that file and continues.
verification: Confirm all required PR workflows pass on the exact final PR head.
Review the search/read error handling diff to confirm protected-content rejection remains fail-closed.
recovery: If an assertion exposes a different failure mode, inspect the actual tool boundary and error description. Keep this test-only unless a reproducible production defect is demonstrated.
